hazards.evidence: Frequently used dishes and bowls are stored on high open shelves, requiring overhead reaching.
A large liquid spill creates a visibly wet, slippery kitchen floor.
A long electrical cord runs in multiple loops across the main walking route, obstructing a walker.
The central walking path is obstructed by multiple loops of cord and the wet area, leaving an unsafe walker route.
